```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%", fig.asp=0.8)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
theme_set(theme_bw())
pd <- position_dodge(0.5)

# Read in simulation parms (and pop truth) -----
load("./simdata/simParms.RData")
parms <- parms %>%
  dplyr::select(pop, mech, sampsize,
                rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a,
                mu)

# Read in all estimators ----
getres <- function(x)
{
  load(x)
  return(res)
}

# Gold standard estimator
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "gold")
stack_gold <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  dplyr::select(probtype, pop, rep, est_P:ub_P)

# Naive NP estimator
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "naive")
stack_naive <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  dplyr::select(pop, mech, sampsize, rep, est_NP:ub_NP)

# Combine Naive and Gold
stack_naive1 <- stack_naive %>%
  add_column(probtype = "SRS")
stack_naive2 <- stack_naive %>%
  add_column(probtype = "STR")
stack_naive_gold <- bind_rows(stack_naive1, stack_naive2) %>%
  full_join(stack_gold)
rm(stack_naive, stack_naive1, stack_naive2, stack_gold)

# PPMM direct application
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmdirect")
stack_ppmmdirect <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# PPMM-Reg
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmreg_")
stack_ppmmreg <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  # filter to only original 9 NP selection mechanisms
  filter(mech <= 9) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(est_NP:ub_NP, num_s_equals_1))

# Chen methods (IPW / MI / DR)
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "chen")
stack_chen <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# Shadow variable methods
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "shadow")
stack_shadow <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# Merge estimators -----
all <- stack_naive_gold %>%
  left_join(stack_chen) %>%
  left_join(stack_ppmmdirect) %>%
  left_join(stack_ppmmreg) %>%
  left_join(stack_shadow)
  
rm(stack_chen, stack_naive_gold, stack_ppmmdirect, stack_ppmmreg, stack_shadow, filelist, getres)

# Make long and merge in parms -----
long <- all %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(starts_with("se"), or_shadowdr, orse_shadowdr)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, rep), 
               names_to = c(".value", "method"), 
               names_sep="_" ) %>%
  left_join(parms) %>%
  mutate(bias = est - mu,
         relbias = bias/mu,
         cover = (lb < mu & ub > mu),
         width = ub - lb)

# summarize across replicates
part1 <- long %>%
  group_by(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, mu, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, method) %>%
  summarize(nreps = sum(!is.na(est)))
part2 <- long %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  group_by(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, mu, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, method) %>%
  summarize(nreps = n(), 
            mean_est = mean(est),
            mean_bias = mean(bias),
            sd_bias = sd(bias),
            lb_bias = mean_bias - 1.96*sd_bias/sqrt(nreps),
            ub_bias = mean_bias + 1.96*sd_bias/sqrt(nreps),
            mean_cover = mean(cover),
            sd_cover = sqrt(mean_cover*(1-mean_cover)),
            lb_cover = pmax(0, mean_cover - 1.96*sd_cover/sqrt(nreps)),
            ub_cover = pmin(1, mean_cover + 1.96*sd_cover/sqrt(nreps)),
            mean_width = mean(width),
            median_width = median(width))
sumstats <- left_join(part1, part2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(relbias = 100*mean_bias/mu,
         method_f = factor(method, 
                           levels = c("ppmmreg", "ppmmreg0", "ppmmreg1", 
                                      "chenmi","chenipw","chendr",
                                      "ppmm","ppmm0","ppmm1",
                                      "shadowdrP",
                                      "NP", "P"), 
                           labels = c("PPMM-Reg", "PPMM-Reg(\u03c6=0)", "PPMM-Reg(\u03c6=1)",
                                      "MI", "IPW", "DR",
                                      "SMUB", "SMUB(\u03c6=0)", "SMUB(\u03c6=1)",
                                      "Shadow Var",
                                      "Naive NP Est", "Prob Samp Est")),
         set = case_when(or_y == 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 1,
                         or_y == 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 2,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 3,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 4),
         set_f = case_when(set == 1 ~ "Set 1: Ignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 2 ~ "Set 2: Ignorable w/o Shadow Var",
                           set == 3 ~ "Set 3: Nonignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 4 ~ "Set 4: Nonignorable w/o Shadow Var"),
         estimator_group = case_when(method %in% c("P", "NP") ~ " ",
                                     method %in% c("ppmmreg","ppmmreg0","ppmmreg1") ~ "PPMM-Reg",
                                     method %in% c("chenmi","chenipw","chendr","ppmm0") ~ "Ignorable",
                                     method %in% c("shadowdrP", "ppmm","ppmm1") ~ "Other")) %>%
  mutate(estimator_group = fct_relevel(estimator_group, c(" ", "PPMM-Reg", "Ignorable", "Other"))) %>%
  mutate(sampsize_f = factor(sampsize, levels = 1:2, labels = c("NP smaller than P", "NP larger than P")))

# labels for facets
rho_ya.z.labs <- c("Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.2", "Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.5", "Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.8")
names(rho_ya.z.labs) <- c("0.2", "0.5", "0.8")
or_a.labs <- c("OR(A) = 1", "OR(A) = 1.1", "OR(A) = 2")
names(or_a.labs) <- c(1, 1.1, 2)
or_y.labs <- c("OR(Y) = 1", "OR(Y) = 1.1", "OR(Y) = 2")
names(or_y.labs) <- c(1, 1.1, 2)

rm(part1, part2, long, all)

# remove the shadow variable + STR rows that are NA so doesn't plot
sumstats <- sumstats %>%
  drop_na()

# just the competing ignorable approaches (MI, DR, IPW, SMUB(0)) to put separate in supplemental
sumstats_ign <- sumstats %>%
  filter(method %in% c("chendr", "chenipw", "chenmi", "ppmm0", "ppmmreg0"))

# main comparisons (excludes all but one Chen method, excludes PPMM(0) and PPMM(1))
sumstats_main <- sumstats %>%
  filter(method %in% c("P", "NP", 
                       "ppmmreg", "ppmmreg0", "ppmmreg1",
                       "chenmi", # just one of the Chen methods
                       "shadowdrP", "ppmm")) %>%
  mutate(hline1 = 2.5,
         hline2 = case_when(probtype == "SRS" ~ 5.5,
                            probtype == "STR" ~ 4.5))
```

Methods that do not have 1000 replicates (b/c of convergence problems):

```{r}
# methods that do not have 1000 reps
sumstats %>%
  filter(nreps >0 & nreps < 1000) %>%
  dplyr::select(method_f, probtype, sampsize, set_f, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, nreps) %>%
  kbl() %>%
  kable_classic()
```

Notes:

* When OR(Y) = 1 --> Selection is **ignorable**  
  * phi=0 for PPMM-Reg and SMUB
  * Chen methods should work  
* When OR(Y) > 1 --> Selection is **nonignorable**   
  * phi>0 for PPMM-Reg and SMUB
* When OR(A) = 1 --> A **is** a shadow variable  
  * phi=1 for PPMM-Reg, 0<phi<1 for SMUB  
* When OR(A) > 1 --> A **is not** a shadow variable   
  * phi>0 for PPMM-Reg, 0<phi<1 for SMUB

```{r}
# plot bias
g_bias <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_bias, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb_bias, xmax = ub_bias), position = pd, width = 0.3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Empirical Bias", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(sampsize_f + probtype ~ or_y + or_a, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y")  + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
# plot coverage
g_cover <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_cover, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb_cover, xmax = ub_cover), position = pd, width = 0.3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Empirical Coverage of 95% Intervals", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(sampsize_f + probtype ~ or_y + or_a, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y")  + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1))
# plot ci width
g_width <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = median_width, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = median_width), position = pd, width = 0, orientation = "y") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 1, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Median CI Width", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(sampsize_f + probtype ~ or_y + or_a, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y")  + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Main Results

## Ignorable (Sets 1 & 2) {.tabset}


### Bias
```{r}
g_bias + filter(sumstats_main, or_y == 1) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hline1), col = "grey50") + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hline2), col = "grey50")
ggsave("./plots/set1_2_bias.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

### Coverage
```{r}
g_cover + filter(sumstats_main, or_y == 1) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hline1), col = "grey50") + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hline2), col = "grey50")
ggsave("./plots/set1_2_cover.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

### CI Width
```{r}
g_width + filter(sumstats_main, or_y == 1) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hline1), col = "grey50") + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hline2), col = "grey50")
ggsave("./plots/set1_2_width.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```


## Non-Ignorable w/Shadow Variable (Set 3) {.tabset}
